New York City Faces Severe Flooding Amidst Torrential Rain

New York City experienced significant flash flooding on Saturday due to torrential rain. The severe weather led to road closures, stranded drivers, and disruptions to flights and subway services. Authorities issued flash flood warnings for several parts of the city.
